sloka: रथं तस्य समासाद्य भुजमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् ।त्रासयन् रावणं धीमान् हनुमान् वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५९.५४ ।।।।
transliteration: rathaṁ tasya samāsādya bhujamudyamya dakṣiṇam ।trāsayan rāvaṇaṁ dhīmān hanumān vākyamabravīt ।। 6.59.54 ।।।।

translations.english: Courageous Hanuman seeing the chariot of Ravana lifting his right arm menacing him spoke these words.
